# Semantic Scholar

> > AI-powered academic search engine and research tool developed by the Allen Institute for AI (AI2) for discovering and understanding scientific literature.

Semantic Scholar provides intelligent search capabilities, author profiles, citation analysis, and AI-powered features like Semantic Reader and Ask This Paper (powered by OpenAI GPT-3.5). The platform uses advanced ranking algorithms and metadata extraction to help researchers navigate scholarly publications across multiple disciplines.
